reviewScope: Root read every bilingual expectation, performance statement, variation axis and all 40 cases; mathematical quantities, independent transfer, source-scope boundaries, and measurement/simulation safety were checked. This is AI review of authored cases, not performed experiments or learner evidence.
checks: LC time/frequency and energy values, reference signs and phase shifts remain consistent.
C/L cases distinguish component types and passive reference directions. RC examples preserve the authored OR scope of filter types.
Feedback separates signal from external energy; modulation examples require no extra receiver design.
Ray models with n(lambda) may describe dispersion; no false blanket exclusion.
Single-slit minima explicitly exclude order zero; far-field and small-angle assumptions remain separate.
Quantum cases distinguish individual detection from ensemble and path-record claims.
